+def _compatible_tokens(value, check):
+    """Old JSON formatting with one shallow key map per active dictionary.
+
+The map holds original child references, not converted child trees. Python
+dict assignment keeps the first normalized key's insertion position and the
+last value. Keys must have stable, side-effect-free str() for equivalence;
+the scientific schema uses integer labels and strings. Scalar encoding is
+delegated to CPython's JSON encoder (including float/int subclass handling).
+"""
+    encoder = FractionEncoder(indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
+
+    def walk(item, level):
+        if isinstance(item, dict):
+            normalized = {}
+            for index, (key, child) in enumerate(item.items()):
+                if index % 1024 == 0:
+                    check()
+                normalized[str(key)] = child
+            if not normalized:
+                yield '{}'
+                return
+            yield '{\n'
+            padding = '  ' * (level+1)
+            for index, (key, child) in enumerate(normalized.items()):
+                yield (',\n' if index else '') + padding
+                yield encoder.encode(key)
+                yield ': '
+                yield from walk(child, level+1)
+            yield '\n' + '  '*level + '}'
+        elif isinstance(item, (list, tuple)):
+            if not item:
+                yield '[]'
+                return
+            yield '[\n'
+            padding = '  ' * (level+1)
+            for index, child in enumerate(item):
+                yield (',\n' if index else '') + padding
+                yield from walk(child, level+1)
+            yield '\n' + '  '*level + ']'
+        else:
+            yield encoder.encode(item)
+
+    yield from walk(value, 0)
+
